criteria.description: One content-height section, one centered constrained copy region, one h1, one description, one action group and exactly two CTA anchors; zero form/media/dialog/overlay/nav/logo/icon/third CTA
Heading, description and action cluster share a centered axis and finite readable measure at every width
The two intrinsic CTAs wrap naturally at narrow widths without clipping, overlap, undersized controls, or horizontal overflow
Both CTA anchors have distinct resolvable local destinations and remain usable without JavaScript
One labelled section/h1, logical focus order, visible focus, 44px targets, light/dark contrast, reduced motion and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
Content-height composition remains centered and overflow-free at 320/390/639/640/767/768/1023/1024/1280
Vanilla Light DOM, Ren10 layout primitives and semantic/component tokens only; no script or framework leakage
Fresh light/dark/mobile/noJS/reduced-motion captures await Codex inspection
